kpi_metric.name: Delivery Commitment Accuracy
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: (Delivered planned items ÷ committed planned items) × 100, monthly. Track unplanned urgent work separately so genuine commitment misses are visible.

kpi_metric.name: Unplanned Work Interruption Rate
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: (Unplanned urgent work hours ÷ total planned capacity) × 100, weekly.

kpi_metric.name: Estimation Accuracy (Effort)
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: abs(actual hours − estimated hours) ÷ estimated hours, averaged per story, monthly. Single unit = hours.

kpi_metric.name: Late Scope Change Rate
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Stories flagged 'scope-change' after dev started ÷ total stories, monthly. Joint Lead + PO accountability; requires Jira scope-change label + comment.

kpi_metric.name: Critical/Urgent SLA Compliance
kpi_metric.source_reference: project IN (CARIT) AND priority IN (Critical, Urgent) AND type = 'Bug / Impediment'
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: (On-time Critical+Urgent ÷ total Critical+Urgent) × 100, monthly via Jira due-date adherence.

kpi_metric.name: Code Review Rework Cost
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: (Review remarks × rework hours ÷ total development hours) × 100, monthly per developer, rolled up to team. Adopted from Mansi's formula.

kpi_metric.name: Test Coverage of Critical Paths
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Alternate/error flows documented ÷ stories requiring them, aggregated bi-weekly. 'Alternate flow' = error paths, boundary values, integration scenarios.

kpi_metric.name: Permanent Fix Ratio
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: (Permanent fixes ÷ total fixes) × 100, monthly. Requires new mandatory Jira 'fix type' (Permanent/Workaround) field set at closure.

kpi_metric.name: Defect Escape Rate
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Defects found post-handoff ÷ total defects, monthly. Requires the RC QA sheet consolidation (enabling fix).

kpi_metric.name: Production Defects per Release (severity-weighted)
kpi_metric.source_reference: project IN (CARIT) AND created >= release date, grouped by severity
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Count of post-release defects by severity, per release. Report Critical defects on a separate line.

kpi_metric.name: QA Reopen Rate
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: (Bugs reopened ÷ total QA-closed bugs) × 100, monthly. Store as percentage, not raw count.

kpi_metric.name: Development Rework Rate
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: (Rework hours on own stories ÷ total dev hours) × 100, monthly. Denominator rule: only stories where the individual was primary developer.

kpi_metric.name: Testing Remark Severity Score
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Severity-weighted count of unit/impact test remarks (critical edge-case weighted higher than cosmetic), bi-weekly.

kpi_metric.name: Jira Hygiene Compliance
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Defined Jira filter (description + assignee + estimate + current status present) run monthly; (compliant ÷ total active Jiras) × 100.

kpi_metric.name: RCA Submission Compliance for Critical Issues
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: RCA Jira created & linked within 48h of critical-issue resolution. Hard gate: critical issue cannot close without RCA.

kpi_metric.name: Clean Release Rate
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Release checklist sign-off AND zero post-release P1 incidents within 48h window.

kpi_metric.name: Critical Issue Response Time
kpi_metric.source_reference: project IN (CARIT) AND priority = Critical AND type = 'Bug / Impediment'
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Median time from Critical status set to first reproduction-confirmed comment. Report actual hours AND SLA-met %.

kpi_metric.name: Quality-Driven Rollback Count
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Count of rollbacks attributed to quality defects, per release, from Peter's formalised release incident log.

kpi_metric.name: Validation-Gap Hotfix Count
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Count of hotfixes whose root cause was a missed validation step, quarterly, from release incident log.

kpi_metric.name: Deployment Success Rate
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: (Deployments without rollback or P1 within 24h ÷ total deployments) × 100, per release.

kpi_metric.name: Customer Ticket Resolution SLA Compliance
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Zendesk First Reply Time + Resolution Time within SLA ÷ total tickets. Use Zendesk SLA fields, NOT developer hours logged.

kpi_metric.name: Ticket Handling Accuracy
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Tickets not mis-classified as spam/incident + responded within SLA + not reopened within 7 days, ÷ total tickets.

kpi_metric.name: Management-Level Customer Escalations
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Monthly count of escalations reaching CTO/MD level, from Operations escalation log, within 3 business days of period close.

kpi_metric.name: End-to-End Story Ownership Rate
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Score 0-4 per story (refinement written / dev complete / QA passed no major rework / deployed); average across period, normalised to %.

kpi_metric.name: Refinement Readiness
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Story is 'ready' only if AC written + estimated + zero open questions. (ready ÷ total) × 100 monthly via Jira dashboard.

kpi_metric.name: Blocker Resolution Efficiency
kpi_metric.source_reference: project = CarIT AND 'Flagged[Checkboxes]' IS NOT EMPTY AND resolved >= startOfWeek()
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Jira flag added when blocked, removed on resolution; avg(resolved − flagged) via Jira filter, bi-weekly.

kpi_metric.name: Productivity Improvement Impact
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Each initiative requires: Jira ticket + peer review + documented benefit (hours saved / defects prevented / steps eliminated).

kpi_metric.name: Requirement Clarification Effectiveness
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: ((Total reqs − reqs causing rework from misunderstanding) ÷ total reqs) × 100, monthly. Rework tagged in Jira with root cause.

kpi_metric.name: Mentoring & Knowledge-Transfer Outcome
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Per mentee, document one skill area with before/after evidence (e.g. independently resolved a class of issue previously escalated).

kpi_metric.name: Applied Learning Outcome
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: For each learning item, link a Jira where the knowledge was applied and the measurable result (e.g. resolved 40% faster).

kpi_metric.name: Coding Standards Compliance (Automated)
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: CI-integrated linter violation rate per commit — automated, real-time. (clean commits ÷ total commits) × 100.

kpi_metric.name: Documentation Currency & Review Coverage
kpi_metric.measurement_instruction: Jira 'Doc Updated' field as Done-gate + Git branch-protection enforcing review on critical stories. (compliant ÷ required) × 100.
